_comment: RQ1 on the University Course dataset (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Positives include transitive pairs: 555 of 1007 positives are implied by other positives (first conversion, 2026-11-02), so the transitive closure of our predictions is scored (cdlp/benchmarks/README.md). Only labelled pairs are scored. Benchmarks have no course text, so the evidence check has nothing to retrieve and the necessity test has no chunks to write questions from: the agent reported on this dataset is minus_evidence_necessity (semantic + graph checks; decided 2026-11-02; cdlp/validation/README.md, Notes for the paper). full_agent and minus_evidence are still scored but not reported.
